description: Read-first MCP server for Twilio Segment: routing, stale sources, delivery health, governance.
name: io.github.katekruger/segment-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Segment Public API token. Only a Workspace Owner can mint one — Segment App -> Workspace Settings -> Access Management -> Tokens -> Create Token -> Public API.
environmentVariables.name: SEGMENT_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Workspace region: 'us' or 'eu'. No default — must be set explicitly, or the server refuses to start.
environmentVariables.name: SEGMENT_REGION

environmentVariables.description: read (default) | write | admin. Every tool in v0.1 is read-only regardless of this setting.
environmentVariables.name: SEGMENT_MCP_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Separate credential for the Profile API (not yet wired to a tool in this version). Leave unset.
environmentVariables.name: SEGMENT_PROFILE_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Unify Space ID for the Profile API (not yet wired to a tool in this version). Leave unset.
environmentVariables.name: SEGMENT_PROFILE_SPACE_ID

title: segment-mcp
